figmaCorrections.element: Language selector ("English") in the top accessibility bar
figmaCorrections.issue: Text style is Roboto Medium 12, not Noto Sans, violating the Noto-Sans-everywhere DBIM standard.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Re-bind the "English" label to Noto Sans Medium 12 to match the rest of the gov properties.

figmaCorrections.issue: Legend labels use Inter Regular 12, not Noto Sans, violating the Noto-Sans-everywhere DBIM standard.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Change donut legend label text style to Noto Sans Regular 12 (line-height 18).

figmaCorrections.issue: text/hint token resolves to #374151, but the design/code repeatedly renders hint/muted text (KPI card titles, profile role) as #6b7280 and the Ministry line as #1f2937 — token does not match rendered value.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Reconcile the text/hint token: either retarget it to #6b7280 (its rendered intent) or correct the layers/code emitting #6b7280/#1f2937 so muted text consistently uses one resolved value.

figmaCorrections.element: Two inconsistent card styles on one screen
figmaCorrections.issue: Summary KPI cards use border Primary/100 #c8dbf0 with radius 12; inner stat cards use border Stroke/200 #e5e7eb with radius 16 — two different card treatments on the same dashboard.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Confirm the dual card styling is intentional; if not, unify card border color and radius across both grids for visual consistency.

figmaCorrections.issue: Only one summary KPI card ("Schemes as per 10A") uses Primary #003366 for its value while the other three use #374151, with no clear rule communicated — inconsistent stat coloring that is hard to implement faithfully.
figmaCorrections.recommendation: Document the emphasis rule (why 10A is blue) or normalize all KPI values to a single color so the intent survives implementation.
